title: Forget an acceptance evaluation's unconfirmed-submission count when its evaluator ends, and decide whether the host enforces a final authority refusal
outcome: StateInner.acceptance_evaluation_unsettled_submissions keeps no entry for an evaluator delegation that has ended or whose submission has left None. Whether a final "naming authority cannot be confirmed" refusal is enforced by the host (recorded on the target) or stays advisory is decided and documented.
acceptance: Forget an acceptance evaluation's unconfirmed-submission count when its evaluator ends, and decide whether the host enforces a final authority refusal is done
